name: app-black-about-project-text-fade-slide
title: Black About-Project Fading Text
whatItIs: A black slide with a tiny lime 'About project' label and a large centred paragraph whose words switch between white and grey to create a highlight rhythm.
whatItMeans: Alternating white and grey text draws attention to key phrases and mimics a scroll-reveal effect, with no imagery needed.
techniques: Selective grey dimming to emphasise phrases
Centred multi-line statement as the sole element
Lime micro-label as the only colour

vocabulary.definition: Text that progressively brightens as it is read.
A very small label naming a section.
A slide made of a single paragraph.
